_comment: Konomi film tag-pool adapter config — the tunable knobs for level gating. Decided 2026-07-24 (user); floor 55 is the STARTING value for MVP, revise freely. Per-section floor tuning and Map restructuring deliberately deferred until seen live in production.

rating.display: raw TMDB vote_average — MVP default per user 2026-07-24
rating.post_mvp: user-owned distribution transform (and any §8 shrink/percentile machinery it keeps or replaces)

rules.universal_floor: one floor for all sections at film buff; per-section tuning deferred post-launch
rules.empty_section_hidden: a section with zero tags above the active floor is not selectable in the UI (it would be empty), never an error
rules.zero_kw_fallback: films with no tag-kw surface on genres + reception at every level — intended (315 corpus films have no TMDB keywords at all; 23 carry only sub-floor strings)
rules.heat: rarity/heat is percentile WITHIN section, never a global percentage (measured guardrail)
rules.section_order: display order = pillar_tree order in master.json
rules.tag_terminology: tags = collective (genres + reception + tag-kw); tag-kw when the keyword layer needs distinguishing
